journey.name: manual wallet switch requires coin selection
journey.description:
Requires an onboarded disposable regtest wallet with confirmed Savings coins, sufficient Spending balance, and a fresh external unified invoice payable from either wallet. Open Show Details on confirmation to change the funding source. No payment is submitted: swipe only while no coins have been selected, and never authorize a payment.
iOS can open the picker immediately after switching to Savings. Android keeps confirmation visible until the swipe. On both platforms, Back from this picker returns to confirmation, and a further swipe without chosen coins must reopen selection before authorization. Android also requires selection on Amount Continue; switching wallets on Amount stays there.

actions.action: Note the current coin-selection setting, enable Manual, and open the external unified invoice with Spending selected
Open the send details and switch from Spending to Savings
If Savings confirmation remains visible, swipe once to open coin selection
Verify the coin selection screen is visible and no payment authorization or submission occurred
Tap Back without choosing coins and verify Savings confirmation remains visible without reopening the picker automatically
Swipe once and verify the picker reopens before any payment warning, authorization, or submission; repeat Back and swipe once more
Choose enough coins to cover the amount and fee, then tap Continue
Verify Savings confirmation shows the requested amount; open Tags and return without changes, with no coin picker reopening
Close the send sheet without paying
Enable automatic coin selection, reopen the external unified invoice with Spending selected, and switch to Savings
Verify Savings confirmation becomes ready without opening manual coin selection; close without paying and restore the original coin-selection setting
